Subject: OrchardCloud onboarding — PO issuance & spend cap request

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is our vendor onboarding packet and an initial invoice so your team can issue a PO and set the onboarding spend cap for the Q2 pilot.

A few quick notes:
- We split the work into two line items: 1) Integration setup (one-time) and 2) Monthly usage (metered).
- We'd like the pilot spend cap set to $45,000 for the 90-day pilot. If needed we can stage a higher cap after initial milestones.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 210 KB); initial_invoice.xlsx (XLSX, 34 KB)

Can you confirm the PO number and whether Redwood needs a different invoice layout? Also let us know if you need our W-9 or any additional compliance docs.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick sync if helpful.

Best,
Diego Lopez
Head of Partnerships
OrchardCloud Inc.

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrchardCloud onboarding — PO issuance & spend cap request

Diego — thanks for the docs, received.

Two quick asks so finance can provision a provisional PO:
1) Please confirm OrchardCloud's legal entity name and Tax ID / W-9.
2) Can you separate the integration setup into its own line item with a clear one-time cost (we prefer explicit one-off vs amortized).
3) For the monthly usage line item please include a banded rate (0-10k tokens / 10k-100k tokens) so we can map to our internal GL codes.

I attached our PO request template if you want to drop values in — it speeds approvals.

Next steps: once I have the Tax ID and updated line items I'll loop in Finance (Marcus) to provision a PO number and set the provisional spend cap. If you're able to accept our invoice template that helps avoid format back-and-forth.

Attachments: PO_Request_Template.docx (DOCX, 45 KB)

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Laura / Diego — looping in Finance Ops.

I've reviewed the redlined invoice. For onboarding pilots we can provision a provisional PO and set a spend cap subject to:
- Receipt of vendor W-9 (unsigned PDF acceptable)
- PO to be limited to the dates 2026-04-15 -> 2026-07-14 (90 days)
- Spend cap provisional allowance: $60,000, with automated alerts at 75% and 90% thresholds.

I'll allocate PO number PO-004287 as a provisional allocation this morning pending W-9 and final invoice format. Please confirm you accept those thresholds. Once W-9 arrives I will issue the PO as a PDF and send to your billing contact.

Also: please route all future invoices to procure-invoices@redwoodinference.com to ensure automatic matching.

Marcus Lin
Finance Ops Manager

Forwarding final confirmation — Marcus, we have the W-9 in place and Diego has accepted the 90-day window and alert thresholds. Per Marcus's note, PO PO-004287 will be issued as provisional with a $60,000 cap.

Diego — thank you for turning the invoice around quickly. Attached is the signed PO PDF and a DocuSign link for the onboarding agreement. Please countersign the DocuSign before EOD 2026-04-16 so billing can begin against PO-004287.

Attachments: PO_004287.pdf (PDF, 58 KB); DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/share/EXAMPLE-ONBOARD-ORCHARD

Next steps (owners):
- OrchardCloud: countersign DocuSign onboarding agreement (Diego) — due 2026-04-16
- Redwood Finance: finalize and route PO to vendor (Marcus) — in progress
- Procurement: confirm invoice format for automated matching (Laura) — open

If any of the thresholds need to change we'll re-open the PO and do an amendment rather than a new PO number.

Thanks all — Laura
